title: Predictive Pavement Asset Management System
summary: An analytical asset management platform built to model and predict long-term structural and functional road degradation (IRI, PCI) based on cumulative traffic loads and subgrade CBR properties. Utilizing Machine Learning alongside IRC:37 and NHAI maintenance guidelines, it dynamically maps predicted surface distress to multi-year capital budget schedules and interactive financial dashboards to optimize highway lifecycle expenditures.

title: Texify
summary: An automated resume builder engineered for IIEST Shibpur students to bypass LaTeX syntax debugging. It features a reactive, dual-pane React frontend with smart UX auto-bullet injection, Google OAuth domain-locking to college emails, and a Node.js/Express backend that compiles structured JSON payloads into high-quality, ATS-friendly PDFs on the fly.

title: Kolkata Water Infrastructure Forecast Dashboard
summary: An interactive forecasting platform designed to project Kolkata's municipal water demands and sewerage infrastructure loads up to the mid-21st century by integrating demographic forecasting methods and CPHEEO engineering design guidelines.

title: India's Climate Resilience & Strategic Capital Allocation Platform
summary: An empirical analytical dashboard designed to quantify long-range urban climate risk and optimize infrastructure fund allocation across major Indian metropolitan areas using linear regression and algorithmic capital prioritization.

title: Reinforcement Detailing of G+1 RC Building
summary: A comprehensive structural engineering design project executing limit state analysis and reinforcement detailing for a G+1 RC frame building in compliance with IS 456, IS 875, SP-16, and SP-34.

title: CrispURL : Low-Latency Scalable Link Shortener
summary: A full-stack, decoupled URL shortening and redirection platform featuring an event-driven Node.js/Express backend, a vanilla JS/Tailwind CSS frontend, and a serverless Neon PostgreSQL database optimized with B-Tree indexing.

title: Climatic Analytics & Temperature Forecasting Engine
summary: An end-to-end supervised machine learning regression pipeline engineered to model non-linear climatic patterns, optimizing a RandomForestRegressor to predict global average temperatures.

title: Spatial Analysis & Terrain Modeling
summary: A GIS coursework project involving georeferencing, vectorization, and DEM processing for hydrological modeling, executing spatial overlay and proximity analysis to extract watershed characteristics.

title: Building Planning & CAD Layout Design
summary: An architectural and structural drafting project focused on designing residential and storage facility layouts compliant with municipal regulations governing FAR, Ground Coverage, and Open Spaces using AutoCAD.
